about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: I do not only learn tools, I also train analytical thinking and communication.
about.bio: I'm Muhammad Bevan Alqarana, 19 years old, a 2nd semester student at Cakrawala University and a Computer Network Engineering graduate from SMK Perguruan Cikini 3. My background is in networking and troubleshooting, and now I am building skills in data, automation, basic business analysis, and IT support. I am comfortable understanding problems, organizing information, explaining ideas, and independently learning tools like n8n and Supabase.
about.language_desc: IELTS certified for English communication and documentation. BNSP KKNI Level 2 certified in Computer Network Engineering — validated national competency in networking.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A collection of projects showcasing my capabilities
projects.project1_desc: A Discord bot for the word chain game on Beverly Hub server with an Indonesian dictionary database. The bot validates words, tracks scores, and manages player turns automatically.
projects.project2_desc: Admin panel for EskrimKuy ice cream shop management. Features a real-time dashboard with revenue charts, transaction stats, branch comparison, and an AI chatbot that answers questions based on actual business data from Supabase. Built with Next.js and powered by n8n workflow automation.
